overview: Anne's short letter gave the three of them equal room. Hamnet outran the Sadler boy to the bridge and back, and in his own line he has built a water-wheel in the gutter. Judith says that is not what it is called, and she has a second ballad. Susanna has found a fault in your last and will tell you of it herself. The letter she means is the one already in her hand. Nothing in it is illness.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the letter at the Bell and did not answer it there.

parties.name: Anne Shakespeare
parties.context: Was not in the room. The letter is hers.

parties.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
parties.context: Was not in the room. The water-wheel is his line.

parties.name: Judith Shakespeare
parties.context: Was not in the room. The dispute and the ballad are hers.

parties.name: Susanna Shakespeare
parties.context: Was not in the room. The fault is hers to tell.

key_provisions.text: a fault she will tell herself

summary: Read Anne's letter and kept the fault for Susanna
